name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to confirm the tool works end-to-end without disrupting live reviews. The trade-off is delayed feedback on open PRs, but merged PRs carry the highest confidence in code quality, making this the safest first test.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs tests *past* work, not the *current* pipeline—it misses systemic issues in open PRs where routing and prompts are actively evolving. Instead, run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *open* PR; it catches live routing flaws and prompt regressions before they merge, which is the real risk. Settle this by comparing shadow mode results on both open and merged PRs—if open PRs show higher severity issues, the argument is settled.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest *merged* PR first, then expand to the newest *open* PR within 24 hours—this tests both past and present while keeping the initial risk low. Prioritize the merged PR to confirm tool stability, then shift to open PRs to catch live issues before they compound.
